verses.1: In that hour, the disciples came to Jesus and said, “Then who is greater in the kingdom of heaven?”
verses.2: And when he invited the child, he placed him in the middle of them.
verses.3: And he said, “I tell you, if you do not repent and become like children, then you will not enter into the kingdom of heaven.”
verses.4: Therefore, whoever humbles himself like this child, that person is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven.
verses.5: And whoever takes such a child under my name will be accepted by me.
verses.6: And if he were to deceive one of these little believers in me, it would be fitting for him to have a type of worm crawl along his neck, and he would be punished in the depths of the sea.
verses.7: And to avoid the world from being filled with scabs; after all, it’s necessary to get rid of those scabs, except for those scabs that come from within the human body itself.
verses.8: But if your hand or your foot gives you trouble, then cut it off and throw it away from you. It’s better for you to go into life as a fool or a sinner, with only two hands and two feet, and be thrown into the eternal fire.
verses.9: And if your eye is causing you trouble, then remove it and throw it away. It’s better for you to live with one eye, rather than having two eyes and being thrown into the flames of fire.
verses.10: Do not despise any of these little ones, for I tell you that their angels in heaven see always the face of my Father in heaven.
verses.12: What do you think? If someone were to have ten sheep, and one of them gets lost, wouldn’t he leave the other ninety-nine sheep on the hillside, and go look for the lost sheep?
verses.13: And if it can be found, then indeed, I say to you, it brings greater joy than those nine who are not deceived.
verses.14: So, it is not your desire that one of these little ones be killed in heaven before your father.
verses.15: But if your brother commits a sin against you, then try to resolve the issue between you and him alone. If he listens to you, then you will have won over your brother.
verses.16: And if he doesn’t listen, then he will still take one or two more drops with him, so that he can place them on the mouth of two or three people, and thus all the fragrance will be spread throughout.
verses.17: But if they listen to them, then say to the church: “If they even listen to the church, then be like a member of your own people and a true believer.”
verses.18: Indeed, I say to you, whatever is sealed on the earth will also be sealed in heaven, and whatever is opened on the earth will also be opened in heaven.
verses.19: Once again, I say to you that if two of you agree among yourselves regarding any matter that is requested of them on earth, then it will be done for them by my Father who is in heaven.
verses.20: For there are two or three of them who come together under my name; I am in the middle of them.
verses.21: Then Peter came up to him and said, “Lord, how many times must my brother sin against me before I stop forgiving him?” Seven times?
verses.22: Jesus said to him, “I do not say until seven days, but until seventy days.”
verses.23: Therefore, the kingdom of heaven became like a human king who decided to speak along with his servants.
verses.24: After he began to mix them together, he was surrounded by a group of people who were very angry with him.
verses.25: Since he did not have anything to give back, the Lord ordered him to give up everything he owned: his wife, his children, and all that he had.
verses.26: Then the slave bowed down before him and said, “Be patient with me. I will give you everything back.”
verses.27: But the master of that slave drove him away from there, and took back the loan from him.
verses.28: When the slave left there, he found one of his companions who owed him ten denarii. He took that man captive and said, “Apodos, do you owe me some money?”
verses.29: So, his brother called out to him, saying, “Be patient with me, and I will give you back what you lost.”
verses.30: But he didn’t want to do that. Instead, he sent him into prison until he paid off his debts.
verses.31: Seeing what was happening, his companions were extremely distressed. They went to the king and told him everything that had happened.
verses.32: Then, the Lord, who invited him, said to him, “You evil slave! You have incurred all this punishment because you called me.”
verses.33: It’s not necessary for you to forgive your brother either, as I have already done that.
verses.34: And in his anger, the Lord handed him over to those who would torture him, until he repaid all his debts.
verses.35: In the same way, my heavenly Father will also do to you if you do not give one of your brothers from your hearts.
